findings.title: `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` returns supported abilities when `skipToken` / `undefined` is passed
findings.body: When `skipToken` is passed to `useGrafanaPromRuleAbility` or `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` (such as in `AlertRuleMenu.tsx` when `promRule` is a data-source-managed rule or `undefined`), `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined)` is called. For `rule === undefined`, `useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable(undefined)` returns `{ isEditable: false, isRemovable: false, loading: false }`, so `loading` is `false` and `isPluginProvided` is `false`. This makes `MaybeSupported` and `duplicateSupported` evaluate to `true`, and `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined)` returns `[true, ctx.hasPermission(AccessControlAction.AlertingRuleCreate)]` for `AlertRuleAction.Duplicate` (as well as `[true, ...]` for `View` and `Explore`). In `AlertRuleMenu.tsx`, `canDuplicate` combines the ruler and Grafana prom abilities with `||`, so any user with the internal Grafana `AlertingRuleCreate` permission will see the `Duplicate` action enabled on non-Grafana rules even when duplication is unsupported or the user lacks external rule write permissions. When `!rule`, all abilities should return `[NotSupported, false]`.

findings.title: Delete and Pause menu items are still gated on `rulerRule` and never render in the alert list view
findings.body: `AlertRuleMenu` now computes `canPause` and `canDelete` from `promRule` via `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` because `rulerRule` is no longer fetched in the alert list view (`GrafanaRuleListItem` renders `<RuleActionsButtons promRule={rule} groupIdentifier={groupIdentifier} compact />` with `rule` / `rulerRule` undefined). However, rendering the Pause item on line 123 is still guarded by `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` and rendering the Delete item on line 165 is still guarded by `&& rulerRule`. As a result, neither Pause nor Delete is ever shown for Grafana rules in the alert list view (even though `RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx` line 99 already invokes `showDeleteModal(identifier, groupIdentifier)` without needing `rulerRule`).

findings.title: Clicking "Silence notifications" for Grafana rules in the alert list view does nothing
findings.body: In the alert list view, `GrafanaRuleListItem` renders `RuleActionsButtons` with `promRule` only and `rule` (`RulerRuleDTO`) undefined. `AlertRuleMenu` renders the "Silence notifications" menu item based on `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(promRule, ...)`, and clicking it calls `handleSilence={() => setShowSilenceDrawer(true)}`. However, line 104 gates `<SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer>` on `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer`. Because `rule` is `undefined`, `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is always `false` and the silence drawer never opens.

findings.title: Missing `key` prop on `<GrafanaRuleListItem>` inside `rules.map`
findings.body: When replacing `<GrafanaRuleLoader key={key} ... />` with `<GrafanaRuleListItem ... />` inside `rules.map`, the `key={key}` prop was omitted. Rendering list items without a `key` triggers React warnings and can cause incorrect component reconciliation when filtering or paginating rules.

findings.title: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` no longer treats federated rule groups as immutable
findings.body: Previously, `useAllAlertRuleAbilities(rule: CombinedRule)` checked `const isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` and treated federated rules as immutable (setting `Update`, `Delete`, `Pause`, `Restore`, and `DeletePermanently` to `NotSupported`). By delegating to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities(rule.rulerRule, groupIdentifierV2)`—where `isFederated` is hardcoded to `false` on line 245—callers of `useAlertRuleAbility`, `useAlertRuleAbilities`, and `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` will now erroneously treat federated rules as editable and removable.

findings.title: `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` disables export, pause, restore, and permanent delete for Grafana recording rules
findings.body: In `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, `ModifyExport`, `Pause`, `Restore`, and `DeletePermanently` are supported for all Grafana-managed rules (`rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)`, which includes both alerting and recording rules). In `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, lines 302 and 324-330 instead gate those actions on `prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` rather than `prometheusRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)`, which marks `ModifyExport`, `Pause`, `Restore`, and `DeletePermanently` as unsupported for Grafana-managed recording rules.
